facts.text: Under Penn State's 2+2 plan, students can spend their first two years at Lehigh Valley before transitioning to another of Penn State's twenty undergraduate campuses for their final two years.

sources.title: We Are... Penn State Lehigh Valley
sources.quote: Students can spend their first two years at one campus, then transition to another of Penn State's twenty undergraduate campuses for the remaining two years. This approach is called the 2+2 plan
